decisions: General uses the original mode card layout and radio assets; the selected radio is inverted in dark appearance so its full original ring remains visible.
The native tray preserves the original 16/24px optical capsule. Progress/queued/pause marks occupy transparent pixels below it; taskbar appearance is independent of app appearance.
Progress is the unweighted mean of currently running job percentages; tooltips also expose queued and paused counts. A paused mark takes precedence over a queued dot when no job is running.
Mode menu check items are reasserted as a radio group after the native Muda 0.20 checkbox toggle, including a repeated selection.

Capture uses the documented owned compositor scheduling flags, reduced motion, finite-animation completion and a fixed 100ms native composition settling interval. No retry-until-match, masking or relaxed threshold.
